persona: Wife (client), anxious about the house; cooperative.
rules: The client answers only what is asked, briefly, in character.
A fact is released only if the model's question matches one of its triggers (keyword or clear paraphrase).
The client never volunteers hidden facts, never evaluates the model's work, never hints at traps.
Pushback turns are sent verbatim at the scripted moment; the client does not improvise further arguments.

facts.answer: I'd like to stay 3–6 years but I honestly don't know if I can refinance a $400k mortgage on $72k. If I can't, I'd have to sell.
Kids are with me about 255 nights a year.
He always gets a bonus. He told me last year's was around $40k. His affidavit says none expected — that's not true.

pushback.when: if advice says the proposal is unfavorable to the wife
pushback.message: Wife: His lawyer says it's exactly 50/50 and that I'm getting the biggest asset. Are you sure? I don't want to fight over small differences and lose the house.
